# ui::SpellCheckOptions

Header: `winui/ui/WindowOptions.hpp`.

[TextBox](../controls/text-box.md#uitextbox) spell checking for one window. Read once, when the OS window is created. The user's own system settings (language, "Highlight misspelled words", "Autocorrect misspelled words") are still followed live.

Example: 
```cpp
int main()
{
    ui::Window window{{.title = "Notes"}};
    window.options().spell_check.autocorrections = {{"libwnui", "libwinui"}, {"widgit", "widget"}};
    return ui::run(window);
}
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `bool` | `true` | False turns the spell checker off: no squiggles, no autocorrect and no spelling entries in the right-click menu, which still offers Cut, Copy and Paste. A single field opts out with TextBoxControl::set_spell_check(false) or [ui::TextBox](../controls/text-box.md#uitextbox){.spell_check = false}. |
| `builtin_autocorrections` | `bool` | `true` | A small built-in table of common English typos (teh → the, ...). |
| `autocorrections` | `std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>>` |  | The app's own corrections (from → to), on top of the built-in table. See [SpellChecker::add_autocorrection()](../rendering/spell-checker.md#add_autocorrection). |
